android.extraProguardRules:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# R8 is ENABLED for release builds (android.enableMinifyInReleaseBuilds=true in
# android/gradle.properties, 2026-09-16) to clear Play Console's "DEX code
# optimization is below our threshold" item.
#
# Most of the stack brings its own rules through `consumerProguardFiles` and does
# NOT need anything here: expo-modules-core (keeps every `Module` subclass,
# `Record`, `SharedObject`, `Enumerable`, `ExpoView`), react-native-reanimated,
# react-native-svg, react-native-iap (`com.margelo.nitro.iap.**`), the React
# Native AAR itself, and the Firebase/Play Services/Play Billing artifacts.
# Only what is NOT covered belongs below.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Readable Crashlytics stack traces. Without these the obfuscated frames are
# only resolvable through the mapping file, and `firebaseCrashlytics
# { mappingFileUploadEnabled }` is not configured in this project.
-keepattributes SourceFile,LineNumberTable
-renamesourcefileattribute SourceFile

# react-native-reanimated (kept from the original file; its own consumer rules
# cover the library, these cover the host-side lookups).
-keep class com.swmansion.reanimated.** { *; }
-keep class com.facebook.react.turbomodule.** { *; }

# react-native-nitro-modules — the Play Billing bridge under react-native-iap.
# Nitro resolves HybridObjects from C++ by class and member NAME through JNI, so
# nothing in the core package may be renamed or removed. react-native-iap ships
# rules for `com.margelo.nitro.iap.**` but nothing covers Nitro core, and its
# `consumer-rules.pro` explicitly leaves `com.margelo.nitro.modules.**` to the
# app (it is commented out there).
-keep class com.margelo.nitro.** { *; }

# OpenIAP (the Google Play Billing client react-native-iap delegates to) needs
# NOTHING here: its AAR ships a `proguard.txt` that keeps `dev.hyo.openiap.OpenIAP`,
# `dev.hyo.openiap.models.**` and `dev.hyo.openiap.listener.**`, and the library
# does not use kotlinx.serialization, so the rest is safe to rename. Note the
# Maven groupId (io.github.hyochan.openiap) is NOT the package name (dev.hyo.openiap)
# — a keep rule written against the groupId matches nothing.

# Kotlin coroutines / serialization internals used across the native modules.
-keepclassmembernames class kotlinx.** { volatile <fields>; }

# Hermes / JSI entry points that RN looks up by name.
-keep class com.facebook.jni.** { *; }
